loop_structure.changed_factor: Termination boundary of an activated representation-discontinuity predicate carrier
loop_structure.summary: The task, one supplied anchor, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract enter one non-authoring terminal-witness call, which commits exactly one anchor-negative terminal postcondition. That witness and the byte-identical anchor enter one non-authoring causal backchainer, which fixes one minimal implementation-neutral preimage. The same anchor and unchanged closure enter one non-authoring predicate-transport corridor composer, which preserves identity custody, activates the champion's unchanged bridge at the first qualifying heterogeneous edge, and can keep that single carrier active through one maximal source-grounded unbranched reconstruction corridor before deterministically terminating it. The untouched anchor and sole corridor-bound preimage enter one final whole-system producer, which realizes the unchanged closure in one working lineage and emits the only complete engine.

recent_outcomes.changed_factor: Semantic carrier used for a fixed causal edge when anchor-native producer and consumer representations differ
recent_outcomes.hypothesis: The sole final producer should receive a realizable closure when one prerequisite crosses an intentional representation boundary: direct edges remain custody-identified, while one proven heterogeneous edge carries the invariant actually needed by its consumer. This should reduce duplicate state, overbroad common ownership, accidental global normalization, and impossible handoff instructions while preserving the promoted outcome-first causal discipline. Under the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo.
recent_outcomes.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate source exists, the loop can now distinguish a genuinely missing same-representation handoff from an existing causal handoff implemented by reconstruction into another representation. On exactly the first qualifying fixed edge it converts OPEN_IDENTITY_CUSTODY into one proof-carrying PREDICATE_TRANSPORT relation whose producer predicate, anchor-native reconstruction, freshness rule, and consumer predicate compose. The promoted champion can only demand identity custody or leave an open handoff; prior semantic-transduction families replace or normalize whole-engine representations rather than transporting one unchanged causal obligation across a retained heterogeneous boundary.
recent_outcomes.emergent_capability: Detect one source-proven heterogeneous causal boundary before authoring and carry the fixed prerequisite across it as one relational predicate bridge, preserving the producer obligation, reconstruction relation, freshness semantics, and consumer satisfaction condition without merging representations or adding a causal target.
recent_outcomes.strengths: Directly answers a promoted-champion risk using the same sole witness and fixed causal closure rather than reopening target selection.; Preserves native heterogeneous representations and transports only the required predicate, which generalizes to compilers, services, agents, data pipelines, caches, and stateful search engines.; Uses one deterministic first-edge trigger and one relational bridge, with no replicated agents, candidates, engines, components, samples, alternatives, rankings, or best-of-N selection.; Keeps every runtime role within the four-call ceiling and leaves source authoring exclusively to one final whole-engine producer.
recent_outcomes.weaknesses: Source evidence may mistake lossy reconstruction for a relation strong enough to preserve the downstream predicate.; The bridge proof can consume context and distract the final producer when a simple missing copy was the real defect.; Choosing only the first qualifying discontinuity leaves later heterogeneous edges as ordinary open custody obligations.; A relation that is sound on the witnessed reachable domain may fail under an uncommon state or freshness transition outside that bounded evidence.

recent_outcomes.changed_factor: Admissibility proof scope for a representation-changing fixed causal-edge carrier
recent_outcomes.hypothesis: The sole final producer should receive relational transport only when the anchor's existing reconstruction is sufficient for the fixed consumer obligation throughout the edge's source-declared value domain. Deterministic but lossy relations that discard an obligation-relevant or freshness-relevant distinction should remain explicit open handoffs, while genuinely sufficient heterogeneous relations should retain both native representations. This should reduce unsound bridge realization, stale-state behavior, and wasted implementation effort without weakening the promoted outcome-first causal discipline. Under the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo.
recent_outcomes.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate source exists, the loop can now distinguish an existing deterministic representation change from a causally sufficient representation change. For exactly the first qualifying heterogeneous fixed edge, it forms the reconstruction-induced quotient over the source-declared producer domain and requires the unchanged downstream predicate and freshness obligation to be constant on every collapsed class. The promoted champion can record a reachable-domain relational proof, but it cannot require this domain-total quotient sufficiency or deterministically fall back to OPEN_RELATIONAL_TRANSPORT_OBLIGATION when an obligation-relevant distinction is lost.
recent_outcomes.strengths: Directly refines the promoted champion's declared lossy-reconstruction and out-of-domain freshness risks while retaining every supported upstream and final-production mechanism.; Treats representation loss by semantic sufficiency for one fixed obligation, which generalizes to compilers, services, caches, agents, data pipelines, and stateful search systems.; Uses existing static source facts and one deterministic certificate, with no probes, samples, competing relations, rankings, replicated agents, alternative candidates, or best-of-N selection.; Adds no runtime call and preserves one non-authoring contract path followed by exactly one whole-engine-producing call and artifact.
recent_outcomes.weaknesses: An over-approximated source-declared producer domain may reject a relation that is sound on all actually reachable states.; Incomplete type invariants or control guards may force an open handoff even when a stronger source proof exists but is difficult to recover.; The quotient certificate can consume context that the final producer would otherwise use for implementation details.; A syntactically plausible sufficiency argument may still miss an implicit downstream dependency not represented in the fixed preimage.

recent_outcomes.changed_factor: Termination boundary of an activated representation-discontinuity predicate carrier
recent_outcomes.hypothesis: The sole final producer should receive one end-to-end contract when an unchanged causal prerequisite crosses consecutive native representations on one unbranched fixed path, while the champion's behavior remains identical for direct edges, absent triggers, a single qualifying edge, branches, merges, or unsupported later relations. This should reduce downstream rediscovery, duplicate state, accidental common-normal-form rewrites, and invented handoffs without imposing r0029's unsupported quotient certificate. Under the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo.
recent_outcomes.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate source exists, the loop can now keep one already admitted PREDICATE_TRANSPORT state active beyond the first heterogeneous edge. Along exactly one deterministic unbranched downstream corridor it composes the anchor's existing reconstruction relations into one RELATIONAL_CORRIDOR whose entry predicate, ordered native representations, freshness and authority continuity, intermediate satisfaction predicates, exit obligation, and stop reason are explicit. The champion can bridge only one edge and leaves each later representation change open; r0029 only tightens admission at that same edge and cannot propagate an admitted carrier. No prior whole-engine transduction or closure-wide identity map preserves several native representations by composing one fixed predicate carrier through them.
recent_outcomes.strengths: Targets a champion-declared limitation while preserving the promoted witness, backward preimage, closure-wide custody discipline, first-discontinuity trigger, and champion relational admission semantics.; Composes only existing deterministic anchor-native relations on one unbranched fixed corridor, which generalizes to compilers, services, caches, agents, data pipelines, protocol adapters, and stateful search systems without introducing a normal form.; Uses one dependency-order pass, one activated carrier object, one deterministic stop rule, and one final implementation lineage; it generates no replicated agents, candidates, engines, components, samples, alternatives, rankings, or best-of-N choice.; Keeps three distinct non-authoring transformations followed by exactly one complete-engine producer within the four-call Luna-high Fast-priority ceiling.
recent_outcomes.weaknesses: Composing individually plausible reconstruction relations can hide an intermediate invariant that the fixed preimage did not express.; A strict unbranched-corridor stop may leave useful relational continuity open at ordinary fan-out or fan-in boundaries.; The ordered corridor record can consume more context than the champion's single-edge bridge when only one discontinuity matters.; The champion's reachable-domain admission risk remains intentionally unchanged because r0029's attempted quotient tightening was not supported.

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Compositional scope of anchor-native responsibility binding across causal-preimage edges
hypothesis_frontier.before: The binder selects the first grounded anchor-native responsibility site for each fixed preimage node independently, then annotates that node with ingress, egress, authority, lifecycle, and downstream handoff facts; adjacent node records need not prove that the upstream egress and downstream ingress are the same causal value at one concrete transfer boundary.
hypothesis_frontier.after: The binder traverses the same fixed nodes once in dependency order and emits one closure-wide custody map: a node site is admitted under the champion's existing first-grounded-site rule only together with one source-grounded custody record for every incident fixed edge, making the upstream egress predicate, existing transport or first missing handoff boundary, downstream ingress predicate, value identity, and authority transfer compose into one uninterrupted prerequisite-to-terminal chain.
hypothesis_frontier.evidence: matched batch 2W/1L/0T, median delta 20.043000000000006, candidate invalid count 0

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Semantic carrier used for a fixed causal edge when anchor-native producer and consumer representations differ
hypothesis_frontier.before: Every fixed preimage edge must carry the same causal value through one identity-preserving alias, copy, or transport under one authority epoch. If no such path exists, the edge remains an open identity-custody obligation even when the consumer intentionally reconstructs a different representation of the producer predicate.
hypothesis_frontier.after: The closure-wide binding pass retains identity custody wherever source evidence supports it, but on the first fixed edge whose producer and consumer are source-grounded as intentionally heterogeneous it transitions exactly once from open identity custody to one relational predicate bridge: a deterministic anchor-native reconstruction relation carries the unchanged prerequisite predicate, freshness condition, and consumer satisfaction obligation without requiring object or representation identity.
hypothesis_frontier.evidence: matched batch 3W/0L/0T, median delta 23.357, candidate invalid count 0

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Admissibility proof scope for a representation-changing fixed causal-edge carrier
hypothesis_frontier.before: At the first fixed edge with no identity-preserving handoff and one source-grounded deterministic reconstruction, the transport compiler may admit a relational bridge from a reachable-domain condition showing that the reconstruction satisfies the consumer predicate. The proof can remain specific to the witnessed reachable subdomain and need not show that reconstruction preserves every producer-state distinction required by the downstream predicate and freshness obligation across the edge's full source-declared value domain.
hypothesis_frontier.after: At that same first fixed heterogeneous edge, with the same endpoints, representations, reconstruction, predicates, freshness rule, authority, and single-bridge limit, the compiler admits the relational bridge only when one source-grounded predicate-quotient certificate proves that every producer state allowed by the edge's existing type invariants and direct control guards maps to a consumer state satisfying the unchanged downstream predicate, and that no two producer states collapsed by reconstruction differ on any fact required by that predicate or freshness rule. If this domain-total obligation cannot be proved from existing source facts, the edge remains one open relational-transport obligation and no bridge is emitted.
hypothesis_frontier.evidence: matched batch 1W/2L/0T, median delta -4.00800000000001, candidate invalid count 0

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Termination boundary of an activated representation-discontinuity predicate carrier
hypothesis_frontier.before: At the first fixed edge satisfying the champion's source-grounded representation-discontinuity trigger, the compiler admits one relational predicate bridge under the champion's reachable-domain reconstruction evidence and terminates that carrier at the edge's immediate consumer. Even if that consumer is the sole producer of the next fixed edge and the anchor deterministically reconstructs the same downstream obligation into another native representation, the later heterogeneous edge is left as an ordinary open custody obligation.
hypothesis_frontier.after: The same first edge, trigger, reachable-domain admission rule, endpoint sites, reconstruction evidence, predicates, freshness rule, and single-carrier limit activate the same relational transport. Instead of terminating automatically at its immediate consumer, that one carrier remains active only along the maximal consecutive source-grounded unbranched corridor in which each current consumer is the sole producer of the next fixed edge and the next existing deterministic reconstruction composes the unchanged downstream obligation under continuous freshness and read authority. It terminates deterministically at the first identity-preserving handoff, branch or merge, predicate discontinuity, authority or freshness break, missing relation, or terminal node, and emits one ordered relational-corridor record rather than multiple bridges.
hypothesis_frontier.evidence: matched batch 3W/0L/0T, median delta 113.977, candidate invalid count 0

evaluation_protocol.anchor_refresh_rule: freeze the panel per round; refresh current and alternate only after promotion
evaluation_protocol.pair_rule: candidate Elo point estimate versus incumbent Elo point estimate
evaluation_protocol.batch_rule: complete three valid pairs; candidate wins > losses; candidate median Elo > incumbent median Elo; zero invalid arms on either side
evaluation_protocol.representative_rule: median-ranked candidate artifact, tie-broken by pair index
evaluation_protocol.token_accounting: separate Sol proposal and Luna internal-loop usage; include invalid retries
